A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para aLight !

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Apoiar na instalação, configuração, remanejamento, desinstalação e reparos dos ramais e hotlines que atendem ao sistema de Telefonia TDM/IP da Light (Cisco, Alcatel, Etradeal e qualquer outro a ser adquirido pela Light), gateways, Centrais Telefônicas, VGs, ativos/troncos de voz do Call Center;
  • Gerenciar e configurar equipamentos de rede como switches, roteadores, firewalls e balanceadores de carga.
  • Monitorar o desempenho da rede, identificando e solucionando problemas para garantir alta disponibilidade e segurança.
  • Aplicar políticas de segurança de redes e realizar auditorias para prevenção de vulnerabilidades.
  • Atuar no suporte técnico avançado e na resolução de incidentes relacionados à infraestrutura de rede.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de infraestrutura, projetos telecom, segurança da informação e desenvolvimento para garantir a integração e performance da rede.
  • Manter documentação atualizada dos processos e configurações da rede.
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e propor melhorias na infraestrutura de redes.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Telecomunicações ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em administração de redes corporativas.
  • Conhecimento avançado em protocolos de redes (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS), balanceadores F5 , SD-WAN
  • Experiência com equipamentos Cisco, Juniper, Datacom, Fortinet.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds, etc.)
  • Conhecimento em segurança de redes (firewalls, VPN, IDS/IPS).
  • Certificações desejáveis: CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, CISSP, entre outras.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa e resolver problemas complexos.

This role is an opportunity for a hands‑on engineer with eagerness to learn, a passion for Linux and open source technologies to work with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

We regularly solve interesting, technical problems. From triaging complex cloud environments, desktop and server issues, Linux kernel crashes we've never seen before to OS configuration issues and root cause analysis, we provide an expert level of support and satisfaction to our peer groups and customers. You will be accountable for delivering an outstanding technical support experience on the full technical stack at Canonical, across cloud, desktop and IoT. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers. This is a globally remote role.

Location: This is a globally remote role.

The role entails

  • Working from your remote home office to provide technical support for employees.

  • Keeping on learning as our products and services grow and evolve.
  • Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix.

  • Identifying and suggesting any opportunities to provide a better service.
  • Participating in a regular weekend working rotation.

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path. Preferable majors: Computer Science, MIS, Electrical Engineering, etc.
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation.
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results.
  • Experience with Linux troubleshooting (collecting logs and stack traces, fine-tuning by editing configuration files).
  • Knowledge or basic hands‑on experience on 2 or more of:
    • Linux server administration
    • Programming fundamentals in any language (bash, Perl, Ruby, Javascript, C or C++, Go)
    • Networking (bonding, firewalling, bridging, switching, network file system tuning, MTU issues, etc.)
    • Virtualization / Cloud computing concepts (provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, etc.)
  • Ability to learn quickly, thrive on change and handle the pressure of a customer facing job.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi‑cultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long.

Noting that we require and will perform a background check for this role.

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • Experience supporting virtualized environments (KVM, Virtual Box, VMWare).
  • Experience with other open‑source desktop technologies.
  • Active contribution to open-source projects/forum/code.

What we offer colleagues

description:
Technology Product Manager

Department: Technology

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Technology Product Manager works closely with the Business Stakeholders and the FIFA Products & Business Engagement team to define the product vision and roadmap for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

In this context, the Technology Products Manager serves as the primary liaison between the Business Stakeholders and FIFA Technology and is responsible for the planning and delivery of all Product within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 portfolio.

The Technology Product Manager is responsible for ensuring that the stakeholder’s needs and expectations are met.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Be accountable for the complete lifecycle of the Products in scope; Including delivery, operations, and release planning.
  • Establish and maintain a trust relationship with the Business Stakeholders.
  • Ensure proper alignment between the FIFA HQ and FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Create and agree together with the Business Stakeholders a Product long-term vision, roadmap, and strategy.
  • Build and maintain Product awareness and coordinate the Product Roadmap across Products.
  • Create and maintain the Product backlog according to the priorities given by the Business Stakeholders.
  • Lead the Product Backlog delivery ensuring continuous acceptance from the business throughout the delivery.
  • Ensure the Product delivers high-quality User Experience.
  • Understand the Product requirements and propose innovative solutions.
  • Facilitate the engagement and coordination of all Technology capabilities, as well as the non-IT areas involved, during the Product Lifecycle, such as IT Architecture, IT Security, Legal, Procurement, Branding, among others.
  • Facilitate and drive the actions that lead to the definition of the Product budget, as well as ensuring its efficient management and utilization throughout the Product Lifecycle.
  • Identify risks relevant to the Product and propose risk treatment strategies.
  • Plan and run regular Product Board meetings.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree in computer science, Engineering or equivalent professional experience.

Qualification

  • Solid technical background with understanding or hands-on experience in software development/implementation.
  • In-depth knowledge of various delivery methodologies: such as Agile, in particular Scrum.
  • Proven record of successful deliveries of various complexities within Global and Multi-cultural organizations.
  • Experience with working close to UX/UI designer and development teams.
  • Experience in requirements gathering for web applications and subsequent translation of requirements in user stories.
  • Be familiar with hands-on operations in a highly demanding environment.
  • Good knowledge of Azure DevOps (or other backlog management tools).
  • Good knowledge of IT Service Management and Change Management, and solutions that support that capability (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Good knowledge of Power BI or other data analytics solutions
  • Strong experience in Service Management and ITIL Framework is an asset.

Experience

  • At least 8+ years of proven work experience in similar roles; ideally, within Delivery areas or related.
  • Proven work experience as a Product Manager / Product Owner for at least 5 years within the IT field.

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent teamwork and leadership skills
  • Excellent written, verbal, and active listening communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Conflict resolution skills are a must.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Proven ability to manage teams remotely.
  • Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High sense of accountability, trustworthiness, and ethics.
  • Customer and results oriented.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Certification on one or more of different delivery methodologies, e.g., Professional Scrum Product Owner, Scrum Master, PMI-PMP, PMI-ACP is an asset.

title: Senior Director, Consumer & Shopper Insights Brazil, LATAM
description:
Location(s): Brazil

City/Cities: Rio de Janeiro

Travel Required: 26% - 50%

Relocation Provided: No

Job Posting End Date: February 19, 2026

Shift:

Job Description Summary:

At The Coca‑Cola Company, insights power growth. As Sr. Director I, Consumer & Shopper Insights – Mexico & Brazil, you will lead the generation and activation of consumer, shopper, and category insights across two of the Company’s most critical and complex markets. Mexico and Brazil represent diverse consumer cultures, highly fragmented retail ecosystems, strong Traditional Trade, rapidly evolving digital behaviors, and significant affordability and executional dynamics. This role is accountable for translating deep human understanding, advanced analytics, and category foresight into strategies that drive market share, profitability, and long‑term brand relevance across both markets.

You will serve as a senior insights leader and strategic thought partner to Marketing, Commercial, Strategy, and Bottling System leadership, while maintaining strong connectivity with the LATAM and Global Insights networks.

What You’ll Do for Us

  1. Lead the Consumer & Shopper Agenda for Mexico and Brazil
    • Own the integrated Consumer & Shopper Insights strategy for both markets, aligning to local priorities, category needs, and global frameworks.
    • Provide thought leadership across categories and channels—Traditional Trade, Modern Trade, On‑Premise, eCommerce—grounded in local behaviors and tensions.
  2. Translate Human Understanding Into Business Guidance
    • Act as the single point of accountability for consumer, shopper, and category insights, ensuring consistency in frameworks while keeping them locally relevant.
    • Turn human motivations, barriers, and behaviors into actionable recommendations for marketing, commercial, and innovation teams.
    • Influence decisions on portfolio strategy, execution priorities, media focus, and recruitment strategies through insight‑driven narratives.
  3. Bring Analytical Excellence and Next‑Gen Insight Capabilities
    • Integrate multiple data sources—syndicated, shopper card, bottler, first‑party digital, and proprietary research—to deliver coherent, holistic insights.
    • Apply next‑gen insight capabilities—developed in partnership with the LATAM Human Insights team—leveraging AI/ML models, predictive analytics, behavioral science, and digital intelligence to translate signals into actionable business opportunities.
    • Leverage digital ethnography, social listening, sentiment AI, and cultural intelligence to detect emerging behaviors and whitespace opportunities.
  4. Lead, Inspire, and Build Capability
    • Drive a culture of curiosity and learning across the system, acting as the clear, influential voice of the consumer and shopper to senior leadership and bottler partners.
  5. Contribute to the Regional Human Insights Network
    • Share learnings, frameworks, and best practices with the LATAM Insights organization to enhance regional capability.
    • Bring country‑level trends, signals, and insights to the OU to inform broader strategic decisions.
    • Represent Coca‑Cola as a thought leader in consumer and shopper understanding, internally and externally when appropriate.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required in Marketing, Business, Behavioral Sciences, Analytics, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience in Consumer Insights, Shopper Insights, Market Research, Analytics, Category Management, or Innovation within CPG or related industries.
  • Deep understanding of LATAM retail environments, with strong experience in Traditional Trade, Modern Trade, On‑Premise, and digital channels.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive decisions across complex, matrixed, and multimarket organizations.
  • Strong expertise in Nielsen, Kantar/Worldpanel, shopper data, and proprietary research platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience with advanced analytics, AI/ML applications, and next‑gen insights ecosystems.
  • Exceptional storytelling, data visualization, and fact‑based selling skills.
  • Strong people leadership capabilities with a track record of building and inspiring diverse teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, operate with autonomy, and thrive in ambiguity.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish or Portuguese; proficiency in all three is a strong advantage.

What We Can Do for You

  • Iconic Brands in Critical Markets: Lead insights for Coca‑Cola’s two largest and most influential markets in Latin America.
  • Enterprise Level Impact: Shape decisions that influence brands, customers, bottlers, and millions of consumers every day.
  • Exposure to World‑class Leadership: Partner with Mexico, Brazil, LATAM, and Global leaders across marketing, strategy, and insights.
  • Growth & Learning Culture: Be part of a learning organization that values curiosity, innovation, and bold thinking.

Skills

Advertising, Analytics, Customer Insights, Data Analysis, Marketing, Researching

Our Purpose and Growth Culture

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca‑Cola.

title: Senior Manager, Ticketing Customer Relations
description:
Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Ticketing Customer Relations Senior Manager is responsible for supporting the definition and implementation of the comprehensive Ticketing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) strategy in close collaboration with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management. Serving as the primary liaison in the host country, this role oversees the entire Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country, providing mentorship and direction and ensuring that all managers and staff meet established objectives throughout the project lifecycle.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reporting operationally to the Team Lead Ticketing CRM, acting as the primary Ticketing CRM liaison in the Host Country with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout the project.
  • Overseeing and managing the performance of the Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country through the implementation of effective processes, KPIs, service levels, escalation paths, and quality‑assurance plans.
  • Coordinating with other ticketing teams and FIFA functional areas to ensure cohesive and effective project delivery.
  • Handling all types of escalations with a solution‑oriented approach, ensuring efficient resolution of complex cases while keeping FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management informed.
  • Leading the identification, mitigation, and resolution of risks and issues and responding to major customer‑impacting incidents to minimise operational impact and reputational risk.
  • Ensuring the effective delivery of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy, including ticketing rules, policies, procedures, pricing, and ticket products, in line with legal requirements and ticketing objectives, ensuring fair and transparent access to tickets for as many fans as possible.
  • Overseeing sales data and demographic analysis to support the ongoing refinement of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy.
  • Translating the overall Ticketing Strategy into clear, actionable requirements that guide delivery across all Ticketing CRM functional areas.
  • Ensuring an efficient and optimised customer experience by defining and implementing the end‑to‑end customer journey for both general public and group sales customers, identifying service gaps, and implementing improvements across all channels.
  • Planning and implementing effective customer care for all ticketing customers, including organising and implementing automated customer‑care solutions for general public customers and ensuring high‑quality one‑to‑one support for both general public and group sales customers.
  • Ensuring full compliance with data protection laws, ticketing rules, terms, legal requirements, and internal policies, including the enforcement of internal control measures and access‑control policies.
  • Managing RFPs and service provider relationships to ensure external partners are contracted in a timely manner and meet all obligations related to service quality, processes, and customer data.
  • Overseeing Ticketing CRM reporting on customer care performance and trends, using data insights to enhance proactive communication and improve the overall customer experience.
  • Planning and delivering all ticketing sales collaterals and communications, and overseeing customer communications by planning, approving, and coordinating emails, notifications, FIFA.com content, FAQs, and manuals, ensuring mandatory legal documents are accurately presented and that tone and accuracy are consistently maintained, while ensuring proactive communication reduces the need for one‑to‑one support.
  • Ensuring the effective gathering of requirements for ticketing systems and communication channels and overseeing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to guarantee system performance and readiness.
  • Ensuring effective communication channels for proactive communication and customer care for both general public and group sales customers.

YOUR PROFILE

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record in large scale customer relations management within complex, high‑volume ticketing or major event environments; demonstrates strong leadership capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast‑paced, multicultural, and highly regulated environment.

Key requirements include:

  • Significant experience in customer service or ticketing operations within sports organisations or other high‑volume environments.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritise, plan, and deliver under pressure and within tight timelines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams and external stakeholders, including headquarters‑level entities, service providers, and technical teams.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The ideal candidate will bring experience in some of the following areas:

  • Expertise in defining CRM strategies, customer journeys, and service delivery frameworks to optimise the end‑to‑end customer experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex customer issues and coordinate cross‑functional responses to high‑impact incidents.
  • Solid understanding of data protection requirements and internal accountability processes to ensure full compliance with legal and operational standards.
  • Proficiency in managing RFPs and service‑provider relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret performance trends and translate data insights into actionable operational improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to oversee customer‑facing content, ensure accuracy and consistency, and support proactive communication strategies.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise and deliver complex workstreams within tight timelines.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders, demonstrating cultural awareness and high levels of discretion.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, communication channels, and User Acceptance Testing processes.

title: Senior Director, Consumer & Shopper Insights Brazil, LATAM
description:
Overview

At The Coca‑Cola Company, insights power growth. As Sr. Director I, Consumer & Shopper Insights – Mexico & Brazil, you will lead the generation and activation of consumer, shopper, and category insights across two of the Company’s most critical and complex markets. Mexico and Brazil represent diverse consumer cultures, highly fragmented retail ecosystems, strong Traditional Trade, rapidly evolving digital behaviors, and significant affordability and executional dynamics. This role translates deep human understanding, advanced analytics, and category foresight into strategies that drive market share, profitability, and long‑term brand relevance across both markets. You will serve as a senior insights leader and strategic thought partner to Marketing, Commercial, Strategy, and Bottling System leadership, while maintaining strong connectivity with the LATAM and Global Insights networks.

What You’ll Do for Us

  1. Lead the Consumer & Shopper Agenda for Mexico and Brazil
    • Own the integrated Consumer & Shopper Insights strategy for both markets, aligning to local priorities, category needs, and global frameworks.
    • Provide thought leadership across categories and channels—Traditional Trade, Modern Trade, On‑Premise, eCommerce—grounded in local behaviors and tensions.
  2. Translate Human Understanding Into Business Guidance
    • Act as the single point of accountability for consumer, shopper, and category insights, ensuring consistency in frameworks while keeping them locally relevant.
    • Turn human motivations, barriers, and behaviors into actionable recommendations for marketing, commercial, and innovation teams.
    • Influence decisions on portfolio strategy, execution priorities, media focus, and recruitment strategies through insight‑driven narratives.
  3. Bring Analytical Excellence and Next‑Gen Insight Capabilities
    • Integrate multiple data sources—syndicated, shopper card, bottler, first‑party digital, and proprietary research—to deliver coherent, holistic insights.
    • Apply next‑gen insight capabilities—developed in partnership with the LATAM Human Insights team—leveraging AI/ML models, predictive analytics, behavioral science, and digital intelligence to translate signals into actionable business opportunities.
    • Leverage digital ethnography, social listening, sentiment AI, and cultural intelligence to detect emerging behaviors and whitespace opportunities.
  4. Lead, Inspire, and Build Capability
    • Drive a culture of curiosity and learning across the system, acting as the clear, influential voice of the consumer and shopper to senior leadership and bottler partners.
  5. Contribute to the Regional Human Insights Network
    • Share learnings, frameworks, and best practices with the LATAM Insights organization to enhance regional capability.
    • Bring country‑level trends, signals, and insights to the OU to inform broader strategic decisions.
    • Represent Coca‑Cola as a thought leader in consumer and shopper understanding, internally and externally when appropriate.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Behavioral Sciences, Analytics, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience in Consumer Insights, Shopper Insights, Market Research, Analytics, Category Management, or Innovation within CPG or related industries.
  • Deep understanding of LATAM retail environments, with strong experience in Traditional Trade, Modern Trade, On‑Premise, and digital channels.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive decisions across complex, matrixed, multi‑market organizations.
  • Strong expertise in Nielsen, Kantar/Worldpanel, shopper data, and proprietary research platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience with advanced analytics, AI/ML applications, and next‑gen insights ecosystems.
  • Exceptional storytelling, data visualization, and fact‑based selling skills.
  • Strong people leadership capabilities with a track record of building and inspiring diverse teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, operate with autonomy, and thrive in ambiguity.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish or Portuguese; proficiency in all three is a strong advantage.

What We Can Do for You

  • Iconic Brands in Critical Markets: Lead insights for Coca‑Cola’s two largest and most influential markets in Latin America.
  • Enterprise Level Impact: Shape decisions that influence brands, customers, bottlers, and millions of consumers every day.
  • Exposure to World‑Class Leadership: Partner with Mexico, Brazil, LATAM, and Global leaders across marketing, strategy, and insights.
  • Growth & Learning Culture: Be part of a learning organization that values curiosity, innovation, and bold thinking.

Sobre a Alvarez & Marsal

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) é uma consultoria global com mais de 10.000 profissionais empreendedores, orientados para a ação e resultados, em mais de 40 países. Adotamos uma abordagem prática para resolver os problemas de nossos clientes e ajudá-los a atingir seu pleno potencial. A equipe:

A A&M Infra se dedica a todos os aspectos do ciclo de vida de projetos de capital intensivo, incluindo grandes empreendimentos nas áreas de Mineração, Portos, O&G, Aeroportos, Siderurgia, Ferrovias, Papel & Celulose, Rodovias, Energia, Telecom, Saneamento e Real Estate. Nossa atuação abrange desde a estruturação de projetos e processos de M&A relacionados a ativos de infraestrutura até todas as etapas de desenvolvimento e implementação, além da gestão dos ativos.

Qualificações:

  • Formação acadêmica em engenharia.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos técnicos adquiridos na formação acadêmica.

  • Habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Sua jornada na A&M

Reconhecemos que nossos colaboradores são a força motriz por trás do nosso sucesso, e é por isso que priorizamos uma experiência que favorece o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal único de cada pessoa. Nosso robusto processo de desenvolvimento de desempenho promove o aprendizado contínuo, recompensa suas contribuições e cultiva uma cultura de meritocracia. Com treinamentos de alta qualidade e oportunidades de aprendizado prático, você pode adquirir novas habilidades e avançar em sua carreira.

Priorizamos o seu bem-estar, oferecendo benefícios e recursos para apoiar sua jornada pessoal. Nossos colaboradores destacam constantemente as oportunidades de crescimento, nossa cultura empreendedora única e a diversão que vivenciamos juntos como os aspectos favoritos de trabalhar na A&M. As possibilidades são infinitas para profissionais de alto desempenho e paixão.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Diversidade Inclusiva significa que abraçamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão, incentivando todos a trazerem seu eu completo para o trabalho a cada dia. Isso permeia a maneira como recrutamos, desenvolvemos os colaboradores, conduzimos os negócios, apoiamos os clientes e fazemos parcerias com fornecedores. É a forma A&M de ser.

Empregador de Oportunidades Iguais

É prática da Alvarez & Marsal fornecer e promover oportunidades iguais em emprego, compensação e outras condições de trabalho, sem discriminação por raça, cor, credo, religião, origem nacional, ascendência, status de cidadania, sexo ou gênero, identidade de gênero ou expressão de gênero (incluindo status de pessoa transgênero), orientação sexual, estado civil, serviço militar e status de veterano, deficiência física ou mental, histórico médico familiar, informações genéticas ou qualquer outra condição médica protegida, afiliação política ou qualquer outra característica protegida por e em conformidade com as leis aplicáveis. Colaboradores e Candidatos podem encontrar as declarações de política da A&M e informações adicionais por região aqui.

Currículos Não Solicitados de Recrutadores de Terceiros

Informamos que, conforme a política da A&M, não aceitamos currículos não solicitados de recrutadores de terceiros, a menos que esses recrutadores sejam contratados para fornecer candidatos para uma vaga específica e em alinhamento com nossos valores de Diversidade Inclusiva. title: Managing Consultant, Customer Success
description:
Company Overview

Libryo, an ERM Group Company, is a global SaaS platform that empowers multinational organizations to understand and comply with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) law and broader ESG requirements. Our platform helps customers navigate complex regulatory environments with clarity and precision. Founded in 2016 and now part of ERM, the world’s largest pure‑play sustainability consultancy, Libryo combines technology with legal expertise to support organizations in achieving operational excellence and legal certainty.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) with strong strategic account management expertise to grow a portfolio of customers in North America and Latin America (NA/LATAM). This is a mid‑to‑senior‑level role with potential people management responsibilities. This individual will lead customer implementations, drive platform adoption, and be accountable for renewal outcomes, customer growth opportunities, and relationship longevity. You’ll work across departments to deliver a high‑quality experience that aligns with each customer’s business and regulatory objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Account Ownership (NA & LATAM)

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned customers in North and Latin America.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, user groups, and decision‑makers across large multinational organizations.
  • Represent the voice of the customer internally to ensure customer needs are heard and prioritized.

Customer Implementations

  • Lead end‑to‑end delivery of customer onboarding and implementation projects, coordinating with internal teams (e.g., Legal Content, RIDE, and Product) to deliver on time and to spec.
  • Work with key stakeholders to map customer‑specific rollouts (global or phased), track milestones, communicate progress with customers, and resolve blockers proactively.
  • Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practice guides to scale future delivery.

Renewal & Retention Management

  • Take full ownership of renewal planning and execution, including pricing alignment, contract coordination, and commercial positioning for their allocated customer portfolio and region.
  • Monitor and improve customer health and adoption through data, feedback, and regular business reviews.
  • Anticipate and mitigate risks that could lead to churn through proactive engagement and problem‑solving.

Strategic Account Growth

  • Identify and support growth opportunities, including cross‑sell, upsell, and feature expansion across accounts.
  • Support proposal creation and commercial scoping efforts in collaboration with relevant stakeholders to enable account expansion.
  • Track and report on account growth potential using insights from platform engagement, stakeholder behavior, and evolving needs.

Platform Mastery & Support

  • As a senior member of the Customer Success team, you will be expected to develop deep expertise across Libryo’s full suite of tools, including the Libryo Platform, Libryo Research, and ERM Assess. This role requires you to deliver high‑level support and guidance to users, ensuring seamless navigation, adoption, and troubleshooting across all platforms. You’ll play a key role in ensuring a consistent, professional, and high‑quality user experience across every touchpoint, reinforcing Libryo’s reputation for excellence and reliability in regulatory technology.

Team Collaboration & Cross‑Functional Coordination

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Legal, Product, Support, Customer Intelligence) to ensure each customer receives seamless, aligned service.
  • Participate in customer health reviews, product feedback loops, and ongoing support escalations when needed.
  • May manage and mentor junior Customer Success team members, contributing to team strategy and development.

Customer Reporting & Communication

Technology Contract Manager

Department: Technology

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Technology Operations, the Technology Contract Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team, and work in close collaboration with the Technology teams based in Brazil and other key individuals responsible for overseeing the relationship, performance, and contract management of our strategic technology partners and suppliers. Drawing on your experience as part of significant sporting event, you will contribute to the success of this global spectacle.

  • Overseeing a diverse portfolio of technology contracts, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and performance standards.

  • Develop and create contracts, NDAs, and SoWs using established templates.
  • Proactively foster and nurture robust relationships within an ecosystem of partners and vendors, leveraging your experience from to benefit tournament in achieving its goals.

  • Apply expertise in reporting financial spend (using tools such as Power BI, SAP, etc.) related to contracts, invoices etc.
  • Lead and oversee tender processes, including initiating and executing technology purchase requisitions via SAP in accordance with procurement guidelines.
  • Coordinate multi-supplier/partner collaborations and contribute to decisions on supplier proposals to continually enhance services, including the development of an evaluation process.
  • Document management of all tender documents, contracts, and invoices in accordance with the storage management requirements.
  • Responsible for ensuring the execution of contracts follow the appropriate workflows via DocuSign.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree or equivalent high education.

Qualification

  • Proven track record in managing and implementing Governance Processes.
  • Extensive experience in running KPI/SLA driven engagement.
  • Significant commercial and contract management experience.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years overall technology contract management experience and minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of managing complex and high spend technology contracts across tier one telecoms and network providers

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent teamwork and leadership skills
  • Excellent written, verbal, and active listening communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Conflict resolution skills are a must.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Proven ability to manage teams remotely.
  • Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High sense of accountability, trustworthiness, and ethics.
  • Customer and results oriented.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset

title: Field Medical Advisor - Brazil
description:
Our client is a clinical-stage precision oncology company focused on developing novel targeted therapies to inhibit frontier targets in RAS-addicted cancers. The company’s R&D pipeline comprises RAS(ON) Inhibitors designed to suppress diverse oncogenic variants of RAS proteins, and RAS Companion Inhibitors for use in combination treatment strategies. As a new member of the team, you will join other outstanding professionals in a tireless commitment to patients with cancers harboring mutations in the RAS signaling pathway.

The Opportunity:

Syneos Health is seeking two Field Medical Advisors (FMAs) to support clinical trial programs in oncology across Latin America. This recruitment requires one FMA to be a resident of Brazil and one FMA to be a resident of Argentina.

This role will be instrumental in driving the scientific excellence, clinical insight, and medical strategy supporting our oncology pipeline and marketed products. The Medical Advisor ensures scientific integrity and alignment with global and LATAM medical affairs objectives. The position will require close collaboration with cross-functional partners including clinical development, regulatory, commercial, HEOR, market access, and field medical teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement the Medical Affairs strategy and tactical plans for assigned products and therapeutic areas, tailored to the local LATAM market (Argentina or Brazil).
  • Establish and maintain trusted scientific relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, and healthcare professionals across LATAM countries (Argentina or Brazil).
  • Provide medical oversight and scientific input to cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment with regulatory and compliance standards.
  • Contribute to medical input in promotional and non-promotional materials, internal training, and advisory boards.
  • Plan and execute national medical meetings, symposia, and congress participation to enhance scientific visibility.
  • Support investigator-initiated trials and local clinical research activities in collaboration with global and regional teams.
  • Monitor the competitive and scientific landscape to inform internal strategy and provide actionable medical insights.
  • Partner with HEOR and market access to develop real-world evidence and outcomes research projects.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (local regulations in LATAM).
  • Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations and CROs, including site selection, Site Initiation Visits, and investigator engagement.
  • Provide scientific review to ensure medical accuracy in materials developed by cross functional teams, including non promotional content and internal scientific training.

Requirements:

  • Advanced scientific or medical degree (MD, PharmD, or PhD) required; oncology experience strongly preferred.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in Medical Affairs or related functions in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
  • Strong understanding of oncology clinical development, evidence generation, and treatment landscape.
  • Proven ability to interpret and communicate complex scientific and clinical data effectively.
  • Experience engaging with healthcare professionals, academic researchers, and medical societies.
  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and presentation skills.
  • Fluency in Spanish/Portuguese and English (written and spoken).
  • Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross-functional, and multicultural environment.
  • Willingness to travel nationally and internationally (up to 70%).

Preferred Education, Experience and Skills:

  • Prior experience supporting oncology product launches or lifecycle management activities.
  • Strong network within the corresponding country oncology community (Argentina or Brazil).
  • Experience leading or supporting investigator-initiated or real-world evidence studies.
  • Knowledge of the corresponding country healthcare system, reimbursement structures, and compliance requirements (Argentina or Brazil).
  • Track record in publication planning, congress presentations, and scientific communications.

Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)

title: Analyst - Fund Administration (Investor Services)
description:
This role is based in our office in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. As an Analyst, you will report to the Associate Director.

As an Analyst, you will play a critical role in supporting Catalyst’s Investor Services team, working alongside colleagues in various departments to provide high‑quality service to clients. You will assist in supporting the full lifecycle of investor transactions, from onboarding and compliance to wire payments support, reporting, and help resolve client queries. This role requires a keen eye for detail, a strong process orientation, and the ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, client‑facing environment.

From a high‑level perspective, the core responsibilities that form your role are broken down into the following categories:

  1. Investor Onboarding
  2. Investor Transaction Processing & Reporting
  3. Client Relationship & Query Management
  4. Collaboration with Fund Accounting & Middle Office Teams
  5. Risk and Compliance Responsibilities

Your Daily Tasks

The following are the tasks linked to the Core Responsibilities that will be expected as part of this role:

1. Investor Onboarding

  • Ensure all required forms are completed and signed off in accordance with regulatory guidelines.
  • Create and input new investors into the RTA systems, following the guidelines stipulated in the Step‑by‑Step manual, making sure all relevant information is registered.
  • Identify any gaps or deficiencies in documentation and proactively communicate with the team to resolve them. Work with the KYC Teams to notify clients of any issues that could delay investor redemptions or distributions.

2. Investor Transaction Processing & Reporting

  • Input investor transactions into RTA systems, ensuring all transactions are accurately captured and recorded.
  • Review investor trade documents for completeness and verify that all necessary information has been provided. Follow up with clients and investors to resolve any issues or missing information promptly.
  • Prepare and generate investor statements for internal review, ensuring statements align with internal records and regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare and submit wire payments to treasury for processing, adhering to Catalyst’s payment and call‑back procedures.
  • Ensure all investor‑related reporting is completed on time and meets the required service level agreements (SLAs) set by the client.
  • Ensure thorough and accurate documentation of all new investors, transactions, communications, and approvals within the internal online environment. Adhere to established naming conventions and utilize provided checklists to maintain consistency and compliance with internal processes.

3. Client Relationship & Query Management

  • Assist with investor queries and ensure a high level of service delivery. With guidance, respond to investor queries about their transactions, statements, or any issues they may encounter.
  • Monitor the different channels of communication including, but not limited to, Teams, Investor Services inbox, Client distribution emails, and Core requests.
  • Monitor the Customer Requests dashboard for pending items and action as needed.

4. Collaboration with Fund Accounting & Middle Office Teams

  • Work alongside the accounting team to ensure timely reconciliation of investor activity.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution of fund‑related activities, ensuring timely and accurate processing of capital calls, fund distributions, and transaction bookings in alignment with the fund’s NAV cycle.

5. Risk and Compliance Responsibilities (AML/KYC, FATCA/CRS)

  • Review incoming investor wire payments and ensure that any third‑party or suspicious wires are flagged to Compliance for review and approval.
  • Assist the Corporate Middle Office with the collection of FATCA/CRS and AEOI documentation in alignment with global regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain organized records of investor‑related compliance documents and reports.

Additional Strategic Expectations

  • Share insights to enable the development of new processes and procedures that will create business efficiency and support delivery of client excellence in service.
  • Maintain awareness of industry, regulatory, jurisdiction, and other trends that could affect the business.
  • Contribute to the creation, development and implementation of new products and solutions to accommodate the businesses continuously changing needs.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with operations staff, business users, project, and implementation managers to achieve desired and elegant solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

Are you excited? We are! Before we get too carried away, there are a few requirements you’ll need to check off before you can apply for the position:

  • A bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • A minimum of 2 years of professional experience in the Fund Administration industry, particularly in investor services, investor transaction processing, including redemptions, subscriptions, transfers, and distributions and regulatory compliance.
  • Knowledge of Cayman Island Monetary Authority (CIMA) regulations and the most common fund structures.
  • Knowledge of Delaware fund structures.

title: Senior Manager, Ticketing Customer Relations
description:
Senior Manager, Ticketing Customer Relations

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Ticketing Customer Relations Senior Manager is responsible for supporting the definition and implementation of the comprehensive Ticketing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) strategy in close collaboration with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management. Serving as the primary liaison in the host country, this role oversees the entire Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country, providing mentorship and direction and ensuring that all managers and staff meet established objectives throughout the project lifecycle.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reporting operationally to the Team Lead Ticketing CRM, acting as the primary Ticketing CRM liaison in the Host Country with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout the project.
  • Overseeing and managing the performance of the Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country through the implementation of effective processes, KPIs, service levels, escalation paths, and quality‑assurance plans.
  • Coordinating with other ticketing teams and FIFA functional areas to ensure cohesive and effective project delivery.
  • Handling all types of escalations with a solution‑oriented approach, ensuring efficient resolution of complex cases while keeping FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management informed.
  • Leading the identification, mitigation, and resolution of risks and issues and responding to major customer‑impacting incidents to minimise operational impact and reputational risk.
  • Ensuring the effective delivery of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy, including ticketing rules, policies, procedures, pricing, and ticket products, in line with legal requirements and ticketing objectives, ensuring fair and transparent access to tickets for as many fans as possible.
  • Overseeing sales data and demographic analysis to support the ongoing refinement of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy.
  • Translating the overall Ticketing Strategy into clear, actionable requirements that guide delivery across all Ticketing CRM functional areas.
  • Ensuring an efficient and optimised customer experience by defining and implementing the end‑to‑end customer journey for both general public and group sales customers, identifying service gaps, and implementing improvements across all channels.
  • Planning and implementing effective customer care for all ticketing customers, including organising and implementing automated customer‑care solutions for general public customers and ensuring high‑quality one‑to‑one support for both general public and group sales customers.
  • Ensuring full compliance with data protection laws, ticketing rules, terms, legal requirements, and internal policies, including the enforcement of internal control measures and access‑control policies.
  • Managing RFPs and service provider relationships to ensure external partners are contracted in a timely manner and meet all obligations related to service quality, processes, and customer data.
  • Overseeing Ticketing CRM reporting on customer care performance and trends, using data insights to enhance proactive communication and improve the overall customer experience.
  • Planning and delivering all ticketing sales collaterals and communications, and overseeing customer communications by planning, approving, and coordinating emails, notifications, FIFA.com content, FAQs, and manuals, ensuring mandatory legal documents are accurately presented and that tone and accuracy are consistently maintained, while ensuring proactive communication reduces the need for one‑to‑one support.
  • Ensuring the effective gathering of requirements for ticketing systems and communication channels and overseeing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to guarantee system performance and readiness.
  • Ensuring effective communication channels for proactive communication and customer care for both general public and group sales customers.

YOUR PROFILE

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record in large scale customer relations management within complex, high‑volume ticketing or major event environments; demonstrates strong leadership capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast‑paced, multicultural, and highly regulated environment.

Key requirements include:

  • Significant experience in customer service or ticketing operations within sports organisations or other high‑volume environments.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritise, plan, and deliver under pressure and within tight timelines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams and external stakeholders, including headquarters‑level entities, service providers, and technical teams.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The ideal candidate will bring experience in some of the following areas:

  • Expertise in defining CRM strategies, customer journeys, and service delivery frameworks to optimise the end‑to‑end customer experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex customer issues and coordinate cross‑functional responses to high‑impact incidents.
  • Solid understanding of data protection requirements and internal accountability processes to ensure full compliance with legal and operational standards.
  • Proficiency in managing RFPs and service‑provider relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret performance trends and translate data insights into actionable operational improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to oversee customer‑facing content, ensure accuracy and consistency, and support proactive communication strategies.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise and deliver complex workstreams within tight timelines.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders, demonstrating cultural awareness and high levels of discretion.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, communication channels, and User Acceptance Testing processes.

Sobre o Grupo Profarma

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição. Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. title: Senior Director, In House Consultant, LATAM
description:
The Strategy function in LATAM at The Coca‑Cola Company sits at the heart of shaping where and how we win in one of the most dynamic and diverse regions in the world.

This is a high‑impact, high‑visibility function that blends rigorous analytics with storytelling, collaboration, and influence—working across geographies, categories, and bottlers to steer growth, challenge the status quo, and future‑proof the business.

Joining LATAM Strategy means being part of a purpose‑driven, globally connected community where you can accelerate your development, shape iconic brands, and make a tangible impact at scale.

As a Senior Director, you will act as an “in‑house” strategic consultant, structuring and leading ad‑hoc cross‑functional analysis and/or projects and supporting the Latam Operations President and the Latam Leadership Team, partnering with diverse functions and organization levels.

In this role, you will be expected to bring clarity to ambiguity, frame the right questions, and elevate the quality and pace of strategic decision‑making at the most senior levels of the organization. You will serve as a thought partner and sparring counterpart to senior leaders, challenging assumptions, surfacing risks and opportunities, and ensuring that strategic choices are grounded in rigorous analysis and a deep understanding of the LATAM business context.

You will own initiatives end‑to‑end, from defining the problem and hypothesis through aligning stakeholders, shaping recommendations, and supporting execution and follow‑through. Success in this role requires the ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics, influence without formal authority, and balance competing priorities across markets, functions, and bottling partners.

What You’ll Do for Us

  • Support and lead cross‑functional analysis, working along with market leads and bottling partners, from diagnosis/assessment to prioritized plans/solutions. This involves a fluid interaction partnering with functional peers, while also supporting, communicating and influencing senior management levels.
  • Support new OU or local markets projects structuring, defining the process, key milestones, KPIs, resources needed, capabilities, and follow‑up routines. Projects or analyses may involve negotiating internally or even with Bottlers, sometimes pushing against opposing interests.
  • Identify and assess new growth opportunities, including new markets, segments, business models, and “out‑of‑the‑box” opportunities, leveraging both internal and external perspectives.
  • Navigate and manage complex stakeholder dynamics, including situations requiring negotiation across functions or with bottling partners where interests may diverge.
  • Support the OU President and the Latam Leadership Team in ad‑hoc requirements such as internal or external forum presentations. This will require strong storytelling skills, writing and presenting effectively, and adjusting to fit the audience with appropriate and relevant messaging.
  • Craft compelling, executive‑level narratives, synthesizing data into concise, action‑oriented stories tailored to diverse senior audiences.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a small high‑performing team, setting a high bar for problem‑solving, collaboration, and impact.

Qualification & Requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in strategy‑intensive roles such as management consulting, corporate strategy, business development, planning, insights, PMO, or related fields.
  • Prior experience in top‑tier or in‑house consulting environments strongly preferred; familiarity with agile ways of working is a plus.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking skills, with the ability to integrate diverse data sources, connect the dots, and develop holistic, actionable perspectives.
  • Advanced synthesis and storytelling capabilities, enabling you to clearly communicate, influence, and align senior stakeholders through fact‑based, decision‑oriented narratives.
  • Proven stakeholder management and influence, including sustained interaction with senior executives and cross‑functional leadership teams.
  • Strong project and initiative leadership, with the ability to structure and drive complex, multi‑stakeholder efforts end‑to‑end.
  • Sound judgment and prioritization skills, balancing short‑term performance with long‑term value creation through a pragmatic, fact‑based approach.
  • Strong understanding of industry dynamics, competitive landscapes, and execution strategy.

What We Can Do For You

  • Iconic & Innovative Brands : Our portfolio represents over 250 products with some of the most popular brands in the world, including Coca-Cola, Sprite, Fanta, Powerade, Fuzetea and more!
  • Expansive & Diverse Customers : We work with a diversified group of customers which range from retail & grocery outlets, theme parks, movie theatres, and restaurants.
  • Purpose Driven : Purpose‑driven approach that empowers our people to protect the environment and communities we serve while delivering safe & quality products.
  • Global Connections : Allows you to develop, enhance and maintain global connections that allow us to move faster and learn from others.
  • Community of Belonging : We’re an organization that believes our ability to continually grow and build the right atmosphere where people feel safe and empowered, lets you bring your best self to work.

Skills: Agile Methodology; Microsoft Office; Communication; Tactical Planning; Stakeholder Management; Long Term Planning; Key Performance Indicators (KPI); Collaborative Leadership; Decision Making; Researching; Process Improvements; Waterfall Model; Storytelling

Senior Director, Creative Strategy & IMX Stills, LATAM

Role Overview

The Senior Director, Creative Strategy & IMX Stills, LATAM is a senior enterprise leadership role responsible for defining, shaping, and scaling end-to-end, consumer centric brand experiences for the Stills portfolio across Latin America. This role sets the experience ambition for the category—ensuring that brand strategy, creative excellence, media, and execution come together seamlessly across every consumer and shopper touchpoint.

Sitting at the intersection of Stills portfolio strategy, creativity, IMX, media, digital, and commercial agendas, this leader goes beyond campaign planning to architect long-term experience platforms and ecosystems that drive both cultural relevance and business growth for the Stills portfolio.

As a core leader within the IMX ecosystem, the Senior Director acts as a regional integrator and thought partner—aligning OU and global ambition with local market realities, and elevating how Stills brands show up in culture, commerce, and everyday consumption moments.

What You'll Do for Us

Integrated Experience Vision & Strategy (Stills)

  • Set and lead the LATAM end-to-end experience vision for the Stills portfolio, ensuring clarity, coherence, and scale across brands and markets.
  • Translate category and business challenges into bold experience platforms, grounded in human truths, consumer insights, and cultural relevance.
  • Design marketing and experience strategies across the full consumer and shopper journey, driving brand equity, conversion, frequency, and rituals for Stills brands.
  • Think systemically and long-term: build experience ecosystems and platforms, not one off ideas or executions.
  • Establish standards to ensure all plans deliver holistic, “no dead ends” experiences across owned, earned, shared, and paid touchpoints.

Creative Strategy, Stewardship & Excellence

  • Act as the senior creative and experience authority for the Stills category, connecting category strategy with creative development.
  • Own and evolve regional Stills portfolio narratives and experience frameworks, ensuring alignment with global brand intent and local cultural expression.
  • Shape fertile creative territories and guide integrated creative strategies across E2E, Design, Digital, Media, and Consumer & Shopper Engagement.
  • Set the bar for creative briefing, evaluation, and quality control, inspiring agencies to deliver breakthrough work.
  • Protect and elevate creative quality and brand integrity from ideation through scaled execution.
  • Champion digital first, experience innovation to keep Stills brands culturally relevant and future ready.

End-to-end Orchestration & Experience Delivery

  • Own the end-to-end experience agenda for the Stills portfolio, from strategic intent through market execution and learning.
  • Orchestrate complex ecosystems of internal teams and external partners (creative, media, production, platforms, creators).
  • Make enterprise level tradeoff decisions across ambition, timing, investment, and resources.
  • Ensure experience consistency across markets while enabling meaningful local relevance.
  • Translate Global Core Creative Ideas into contemporary LATAM executions that drive Brand Love (equity) and Brand Value (transactions, frequency, basket) for Stills portfolio.

Media, Data & Experience Effectiveness

  • Set expectations for media integrated experience strategies grounded in evolving consumption behaviors, media usage, and e-commerce dynamics.
  • Partner with Media, DAO, Analytics, and Performance teams to embed learning agendas and effectiveness frameworks into Stills experience plans.
  • Translate data, insights, and ROI signals into clear strategic direction for creative, media, and experience optimization.
  • Champion a performance mindset that balances long-term brand building with near term commercial impact.

Enterprise Leadership, Influence & Collaboration

  • Lead and inspire senior leaders and teams across functions, geographies, and disciplines.
  • Act as a regional connector for the Stills portfolio across:
    • OU E2E Experience Design
    • OU IMX and Stills portfolio Leadership
    • Franchise Marketing and Commercial Leads
    • Global IMX and Stills portfolio Leadership
  • Build strong, trust-based partnerships with bottlers and key commercial stakeholders.
  • Lead complex strategic conversations, influence senior executives, and navigate ambiguity with confidence and clarity.
  • Contribute to shaping the future of IMX and experience design through Stills category leadership and global collaboration.

Organizational Impact

  • Sets regional experience direction and standards for the Stills portfolio across LATAM.
  • Owns a critical enterprise discipline influencing Stills portfolio equity, growth, and cultural relevance.
  • Leads through senior leaders, enabling scale, consistency, and excellence across markets.
  • Plays a defining role in how Stills portfolio show up in consumers’ lives—not just in communications, but in lived brand experiences.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree a plus.
  • 12+ years of experience across integrated marketing, creative strategy, IMX, media, or experience design.
  • Proven track record leading large-scale, end-to-end experience strategies for brand portfolios.
  • Deep understanding of culture, entertainment, digital ecosystems, media, and commerce.
  • Strong background in consumer and shopper marketing; CPG experience required, beverage category experience preferred.
  • Extensive experience working with worldclass creative and media agencies.
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders in complex, matrixed, multimarket organizations.
  • Exceptional storytelling, communication, and executive level influence skills.
  • English Required. Spanish Or Portuguese is required.

What We’ll Do for You

  • Opportunity to shape iconic Stills portfolio across one of Coca Cola’s most dynamic regions.
  • A leadership role with real creative and strategic influence, not just oversight.
  • Collaboration with top global and regional brands, creative, and media leaders.
  • Exposure to cutting edge experience design, platforms, and marketing technologies.
  • A chance to define how Stills portfolio evolve culturally and commercially for the next generation.

Skills

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. Job Overview:

The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Installation Analysis discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the Installation Analysis discipline. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer solves complex problems and uses discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the Installation Analysis team and other related teams and ensures they work within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master's degree preferred)
  • 8-15 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design

description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;

  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.

Qualificações

  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);

description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Get to Know our Team

In Agoda’s Engineering department, we build the scalable and fault‑tolerant systems. Our systems cover all major areas of our business: website, mobile apps, affiliate apis, inventory and pricing, product information, customer data, communications, partner data, booking systems, payments, finance and more. These mission‑critical systems change frequently with dozens of releases per day, so we must employ state‑of‑the‑art CI/CD, experimentation and advanced testing techniques in order to make sure everything works without any downtime. We also ensure that our systems are self‑healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. In order to accomplish this, we use state‑of‑the‑art languages like React, Redux state management, Javascript, Kotlin, Scala, data technologies like Kafka, Aerospike and Big Data, and agile development practices. Most importantly though, we hire great people from all around the world and empower them to be successful. Whether it’s building new projects like Flights and Packages or innovating on the latest fintech idea or reimagining our existing business, you’ll make a big impact as part of our Engineering team.

The Opportunity

The Senior Engineering Manager role at Agoda is one of the most significant and challenging roles in Technology. The right candidate has both deep technical knowledge and exhibits extremely strong leadership and people development skills. They should also have experience leading large engineering teams and managing managers.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Job description

A pessoa Analista de Compliance Júnior irá atuar de forma colaborativa no relacionamento institucional da organização, contribuindo para o fortalecimento da reputação corporativa e assegurando o desenvolvimento, a gestão e a comunicação das práticas de sustentabilidade.

As atividades incluem a elaboração de relatórios de sustentabilidade, matriz de materialidade, gestão e monitoramento de indicadores ASG, além do relacionamento com stakeholders internos e externos. E também contamos com você para nos apoiar na gestão de riscos e oportunidades relacionados às temáticas ASG, pela gestão de conformidades, prevenção de fraudes e corrupção, e pelo cumprimento dos padrões éticos da companhia, o acompanhamento de novas leis e regulamentos aplicáveis aos negócios — como a LGPD —, a execução de atividades administrativas da área, rotinas de auditoria interna e e o monitoramento e reporte de desvios, com o objetivo de apoiar o planejamento estratégico da organização.

Main responsibilities

  • Apoiar na governança ASG, por meio do monitoramento contínuo de compromissos ou indicadores ASG e projetos prioritários, emissão de reportes recorrentes considerando os padrões de mercado, relacionamento institucional, participação/ construção ativa de eventos, certificações e premiações estratégicas, suporte na construção do relatório de sustentabilidade e apresentações institucionais relacionadas a sustentabilidade, acompanhamento de plano de ação;
  • Auxiliar nos procedimentos de apuração e na formalização das demandas do comitê de ética;
  • Desenvolver apresentações, materiais e esclarecer dúvidas relacionadas com o tema, auxiliar na atualização anual do código, aprovar com os diretores e treinamento dos colaboradores, visando melhorar o fluxo de informações dentro da empresa;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de apresentações, materiais e na execução de testes de efetividade e adequação dos processos da Companhia, visando melhorar o ambiente de conformidade e mitigação de riscos;
  • Auxiliar na atualização/elaboração de padrões e procedimentos do Programa de Compliance, bem como dos monitoramentos relacionados para supervisão da efetividade das políticas internas, através da análise dos processos de compras, pagamentos etc.;
  • Auxiliar no processo de levantamento, revisão, mensuração e resposta aos riscos e oportunidades da Iter e posteriormente, realizar o monitoramento do plano de ação de cada fator de risco sinalizado, através da matriz de riscos, na plataforma ERM Cloud, para garantir o tratamento adequado de cada área;
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento e controle das certidões e alvarás das empresas do grupo (inventário, vigência, encerramento);
  • Auxiliar nas demandas de implementação e manutenção de plataforma para gestão do programa de privacidade, avaliação de terceiros, portal do titular de dados e elaborar e atualizar Registro das Atividades de Tratamento(ROPA), Relatório de Impacto à Proteção de Dados Pessoais (RIPD) e suportar na condução de treinamentos sobre o tema;
  • Auxiliar nas demandas administrativas (pagamentos, requisições, relatórios, indicadores e etc.) da área mantendo sempre a organização e controlando as demandas e prazos.

Requirements and skills

  • Superior Completo em Direito, Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência anterior em Sustentabilidade, Governança ASG, auditoria;
  • Cursos ou certificações em temática ASG
  • Analise de Dados (Power BI, SQL, etc.)
  • Conhecimento em Power BI;
